# FG-REPO-0024

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | [`merge-queue`](../../ops/runbooks/merge-queue.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_invalid_repo_yml_is_repo_config_invalid_with_line_and_reason` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このリビジョンの .forge/repo.yml を読めません。示された行と理由を見て、ファイルを直してください。
- en: The .forge/repo.yml of this revision cannot be read. Fix the file at the line and for the reason shown.
- id: Berkas .forge/repo.yml pada revisi ini tidak dapat dibaca. Perbaiki berkas pada baris dan alasan yang ditampilkan.

## 原因 (cause)

`GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/repository/spec-refs` (M3 X1, action SpecRefRead) read `.forge/repo.yml` at the requested revision and forge_core::repo_config refused it. Not a server fault: the file is the repository's content. The answer is still 200 with `config: "invalid"` and `problem {error_code, line, reason}` (the line is 1-based, 0 for the whole file), so the reader sees what to fix; no reference is resolved from an invalid file (fail closed: never a partial reading). `reason`: syntax (not YAML), not_utf8, too_large (over 64 KiB), not_a_file (a directory, a symlink or a submodule at that path), not_a_mapping, unknown_key (a top-level key other than `specs`, `merge_queue` and the reserved `review`, a `merge_queue` key other than `doc_lint_strict`, or an entry key other than repo / path / version / track / scope — `kind:` was removed by ADR-0023), duplicate_key (in any mapping, read or not), too_many_keys (over 64 keys in one mapping), key_not_text, not_text (a list or mapping where text belongs), multiple_documents, yaml_anchor, yaml_alias, yaml_tag (refused, never expanded), too_deep (collections nested over 16), merge_queue_not_a_mapping, doc_lint_strict_invalid (`merge_queue.doc_lint_strict` is not written `true` or `false`; plan 18 S1), specs_not_a_list, too_many_specs (over 32 entries), entry_not_a_mapping, neither_repo_nor_path, repo_and_path, no_version, version_and_track, version_on_path, repo_invalid (empty, or not a namespace path ADR-0015 accepts), version_invalid / track_invalid (empty or null, not a short tag / branch name git accepts, a full `refs/...` name, or a component starting with `-`), path_invalid (empty or null, absolute, a `.` / `..` or empty segment, a control character, a backslash, a leading `:` (pathspec magic), a drive letter such as `C:`, or over 4096 bytes), scope_not_a_list, too_many_scopes (over 64), scope_invalid (not upper-case letters, digits and `-`, optionally ending in one `*`), duplicate_repo, duplicate_path. Merge queue (plan 18 S1, ADR-0037 (b)): the train lint reads the file at the train's base (the target's tip) to learn whether the repository is strict (`merge_queue.doc_lint_strict`). A valid or absent file there decides alone — a member of the train never weakens it. An invalid one says nothing, so the train's last step decides: a valid file there (the merge request that repairs it) counts with its own value and no file there is not strict, so the repair can land; invalid on both, the repository counts as strict (an unreadable setting never relaxes the rule). When such a train adds no document problem but the base's own problems are still in its last step, every entry of the batch is `removed` with this code and `reason=doc_lint_repo_config_invalid` — the config is the cause, not the members' documents —, the batch is `failed` with the same reason and the target does not move. A train that leaves the target clean lands even then.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The event `forge.spec_refs.repo_yml_invalid` (info) carries `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `repo_id`, `commit`, `line` and `reason`; never the file's text. Read the file at that commit (read-only): git --git-dir <storage path of repo_id> show <commit>:.forge/repo.yml | sed -n '<line>p'. Merge queue: `forge serve` logs `forge.merge_queue.entry_removed` at warn (the severity above is the read API's; this removal is no expected outcome of a member's change) with `error_code`, `request_id` (the batch's), `queue_id`, `batch_id`, `entry_id`, `merge_request_id`, `reason=doc_lint_repo_config_invalid`, `config_line`, `config_reason` (the reasons above), `base_sha`, `train_sha`, `problems` (the base's document problems, the first 20 as `rule:path:id`) and `elapsed_ms`. Whenever the base's file is invalid, forge-checks also logs `forge.train_lint.repo_config_invalid` (info) with `repo_id`, `base_sha`, `train_sha`, `line`, `reason`, `decided_by` (`train_repairs_the_file`, `train_removes_the_file` or `invalid_on_both`) and `strict`. Read the file at the base (read-only): git --git-dir <storage path of repo_id> show <base_sha>:.forge/repo.yml | sed -n '<config_line>p'.

## 対処 (fix)

Correct `.forge/repo.yml` on the branch (a merge request: `.forge/**` changes need a Maintainer's approval, ADR-0017 §2.7) by the reason and line in the answer. The format is in plan 03 §4.4 and forge_core::repo_config. Merge queue (`doc_lint_repo_config_invalid`): land one merge request that repairs or deletes `.forge/repo.yml` — it is judged by its own file, so it lands unless it says `doc_lint_strict: true` while the target's old document problems remain (then FG-CI-0032 `doc_lint_base_not_clean`) — and add the removed merge requests to the queue again (gstn queue add). An auto-merge merge request is held (`merge_queue_repo_config_invalid`) until merge-when-ready is pressed again. Runbook merge-queue, the train lint section.
